title: Green Faced Figure Over Theater
description: A large green faced person with black hair and a black cloak stands in the foreground looking forward with a serious expression. In the background through an archway is an outdoor theater stage with red curtains and a crowd of people watching at sunset.
prompt: A large green faced person with shoulder length black hair and a black cloak stands in the foreground looking forward with a serious expression, positioned in front of a large stone archway. Through the archway is an outdoor amphitheater with a stage featuring red curtains and performers, a large crowd of people seated watching the show, trees and hills visible in the distance under an orange sunset sky.
